purpose: Retain matched M8 recovery measurements, including write regressions and startup versus post-statement idle traffic, as a reproducible baseline for issue #211. No timing budget or correctness input depends on these files.

conditions.conditions: Shared host, no CPU affinity or frequency control. Sequential uninstrumented frozen control/candidate runs after owned CI and builds finished; unrelated host services remain active.

round1-control.jsonl.transformation: Keep all complete JSON output lines byte-for-byte; omit non-JSON shell/runtime output. No field redaction or reserialization.

round1-candidate.jsonl.transformation: Keep all complete JSON output lines byte-for-byte; omit non-JSON shell/runtime output. No field redaction or reserialization.

round2-candidate.jsonl.transformation: Keep all complete JSON output lines byte-for-byte; omit non-JSON shell/runtime output. No field redaction or reserialization.

instrumented-control.jsonl.transformation: Keep metadata, both idle windows, INSERT trace/sample and statement summary byte-for-byte. Omit other statement/trace records and non-JSON output. No field redaction or reserialization.

instrumented-candidate.jsonl.transformation: Keep metadata, both idle windows, INSERT trace/sample and statement summary byte-for-byte. Omit other statement/trace records and non-JSON output. No field redaction or reserialization.
